<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>Investment Advisory and Sub-Advisory Agreements</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> The Company is managed
by the Adviser, which provides management services to the Company pursuant to the Investment Advisory Agreement. The Sub-Adviser serves
as the investment sub-adviser of the Company, pursuant to the Sub-Advisory Agreement. Subject to the overall supervision of the Board,
the Adviser and the Sub-Adviser are responsible for the overall management and affairs of the Company and the Adviser is responsible
for the supervision of the Sub-Adviser. The Adviser is responsible for the day-to-day business management of the Company <FONT STYLE="background-color: white">and
for managing the Company</FONT>&rsquo;<FONT STYLE="background-color: white">s investment activities, including sourcing investment opportunities,
conducting research, performing diligence on potential investments, structuring our investments and monitoring our portfolio on an ongoing
basis through a team of investment professionals; </FONT>however, various rights and obligations of the Adviser are delegated to, and
performed by, the Sub-Adviser. The responsibilities of the Advisers are set out in the Investment Advisory Agreement and Sub-Advisory
Agreement. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>Incentive Fees</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> The Company will pay
the Adviser an incentive fee (the &ldquo;Incentive Fee&rdquo;) that will consist of two parts. In any given quarter, one part of the
Incentive Fee may be payable while the other is not. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> The first part (the &ldquo;Investment
Income Incentive Fee&rdquo;) is calculated and payable on a quarterly basis, in arrears, and equals 12.5% of Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment
Income (as defined below) for the immediately preceding calendar quarter, subject to a quarterly preferred return of 1.25% (5.0% annualized)
or &ldquo;Hurdle Rate&rdquo; measured on a quarterly basis and a &ldquo;catch-up&rdquo; feature. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> The Company calculates
the Investment Income Incentive Fee component with respect to its Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income (defined below) quarterly,
in arrears, as follows: </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT> </TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">No
                                            Investment Income Incentive Fee is payable to the Adviser in any calendar quarter in which
                                            Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income does not exceed the Hurdle Rate for such calendar
                                            quarter;</FONT> </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT> </TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">100%
                                            of Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income with respect to that portion of such Pre-Incentive
                                            Fee Net Investment Income, if any, that exceeds the Hurdle Rate but is less than 1.4286%
                                            (5.714% annualized) for that calendar quarter is payable to the Adviser. We refer to this
                                            portion of our Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income as the &quot;catch-up&quot;; and</FONT> </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT> </TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">12.5%
                                            of the Company&rsquo;s Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income, if any, that exceeds 1.4286%
                                            (5.714% annualized) in any calendar quarter is payable to the Adviser.</FONT> </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> &ldquo;Pre-Incentive
Fee Net Investment Income&rdquo; means interest income, dividend income and any other income accrued during the calendar quarter minus
the Company&rsquo;s operating expenses accrued during the calendar quarter. In addition, Pre-Incentive Fee Net Investment Income may
be computed and paid on income that may include interest that has been accrued but not yet received, or interest in the form of securities
received rather than cash, including OID, payment-in-kind and zero-coupon investments. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> The second part (the
&ldquo;Capital Gains Incentive Fee&rdquo;) is an annual fee that is determined and payable, in arrears, as of the end of each calendar
year in an amount equal to 12.5% of cumulative realized capital gains, if any, determined on a cumulative basis from the commencement
of the Company&rsquo;s investment operations through the end of such calendar year, computed net of all realized capital losses and unrealized
capital depreciation on a cumulative basis from the commencement of the Company&rsquo;s investment operations through the end of such
calendar year, less the aggregate amount of any previously paid Capital Gains Incentive Fees. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 18; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="border-bottom: Black 1pt solid; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">F-<!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->18<!-- Field: /Sequence -->&#160;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&#160;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> The Company will accrue,
but will not pay, a Capital Gains Incentive Fee with respect to unrealized appreciation because Capital Gains Incentive Fees would be
owed to the Adviser if we were to sell the relevant investment and realize a capital gain. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> For the period from May&nbsp;11,
2026 (commencement of operations) to June&nbsp;30, 2026, Capital Gains Incentive Fee of $1,306,940 were accrued and remains unpaid as
of June&nbsp;30, 2026. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>Management Fee</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> Pursuant to the Investment
Advisory Agreement, the Company will pay to the Adviser an asset-based fee (the &ldquo;Management Fee&rdquo;) for management services
in an amount equal to an annual rate of 1.25% of the Company&rsquo;s net assets, payable monthly in arrears. The Adviser has agreed to
waive the Management Fee for (i)&nbsp;the period prior to the BDC Election, and (ii)&nbsp;the 12-month period following the BDC Election
(the &ldquo;Initial Fee Waiver&rdquo;). The Initial Fee Waiver is not subject to recoupment by the Adviser. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>Expense Support Agreement</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> The Company has entered
into an Expense Support Agreement with the Adviser under which the Adviser and/or its affiliates may elect to pay certain Company expenses,
including expenses incurred prior to the BDC Election (&ldquo;Expense Payments&rdquo;). No portion of an Expense Payment may be applied
to interest expense or distribution and/or shareholder servicing fees. Committed Expense Payments must be funded in cash or other immediately
available funds within 45 days of the written commitment, or offset against amounts owed by the Company to the Adviser or its affiliates. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> For any calendar month
in which Available Operating Funds exceed distributions accrued to shareholders for record dates in that month (&ldquo;Excess Operating
Funds&rdquo;), the Company is obligated to reimburse the Adviser (a &ldquo;Reimbursement Payment&rdquo;) in an amount equal to the lesser
of (i)&nbsp;the Excess Operating Funds for the month and (ii)&nbsp;unreimbursed Expense Payments made within the preceding three years.
Available Operating Funds consist of net investment company taxable income, net capital gains, and dividends and other distributions
received from portfolio companies not already included in the foregoing. Reimbursement Payments are applied to the earliest unreimbursed
Expense Payments within the three-year window. The Adviser may waive all or part of any Reimbursement Payment, in which case the waived
amount remains eligible for reimbursement in future periods. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> No Reimbursement Payment
is permitted if, at the time of the proposed payment, (i)&nbsp;the Effective Rate of Distributions Per Share is lower than it was when
the related Expense Payment was made, or (ii)&nbsp;the Operating Expense Ratio is higher than it was when the related Expense Payment
was made. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> Reimbursement obligations
are recorded as a liability on the last business day of the applicable month, except to the extent waived, and are settled no later than
45 days after month-end. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> For the period ended
June&nbsp;30, 2026, the Company had incurred organization costs of $1,441,160, which were advanced by the Adviser pursuant to the Expense
Support Agreement and are subject to conditional reimbursement in accordance with its terms. No related payable was recorded in the Consolidated
Statement of Assets and Liabilities as of June&nbsp;30, 2026, as reimbursement is not probable at this time. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> For the period ended
June&nbsp;30, 2026, the Company recorded $2,174,750 of deferred offering costs and the related payable within the Consolidated Statement
of Assets and Liabilities that the Adviser incurred on the Company&rsquo;s behalf pursuant to the Expense Support Agreement. These costs
will be amortized over a twelve month period to expense on the Consolidated Statement of Operations from the date of the BDC Election. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>Acquisition of Investments from Affiliates</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"> Macquarie, accounts managed
by Macquarie or its affiliates (&ldquo;Macquarie Managed Accounts&rdquo;) and their affiliates may, subject to the restrictions of the
1940 Act following the BDC Election, hold or acquire assets and contribute or sell such assets to the Company or its subsidiaries. These
transfers may occur in kind, at Fair Market Value (&ldquo;FMV&rdquo;) if transferred from Macquarie Managed Accounts, or otherwise at
cost plus roll forward or FMV, in each case as determined by the Adviser, plus related expenses, including transaction costs and a risk
or similar premium. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"> <B>10.</B> </TD><TD> <B>Subsequent Events</B> </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> The Company has evaluated
subsequent events through September&nbsp;16, 2026, the date the consolidated financial statements were available to be issued. Other
than as disclosed below, there have been no subsequent events that occurred during such period that would require disclosure in, or would
be required to be recognized in, the consolidated financial statements as of June&nbsp;30, 2026. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> On July&nbsp;31, 2026,
the Company filed an election to be regulated as a BDC under the 1940 Act. Upon such filing, the Company became subject to the 1940 Act
requirements applicable to BDCs. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in"> Effective July&nbsp;31,
2026, the Company made an election to be classified as a corporation. The Company intends to elect to be treated as a regulated investment
company (&ldquo;RIC&rdquo;), under Subchapter M of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended beginning with its taxable year ending
December&nbsp;31, 2026, and for taxable years beginning with the taxable year that begins on the effective date of the election to be
treated as a RIC (the &ldquo;RIC Election Date&rdquo;), intends to continue to qualify annually thereafter as a RIC. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"> On July&nbsp;31, 2026,
the Company commenced offering Series&nbsp;A Cumulative Preferred Shares, par value $0.01 per share (the &ldquo;Series&nbsp;A Preferred
Shares&rdquo;), to unaffiliated individual investors who are &ldquo;accredited investors&rdquo; as defined in Regulation D of the Securities
Act. Through the date the consolidated financial statements were issued, the Company had issued 515 Series&nbsp;A Preferred Shares for
aggregate proceeds of approximately $1,545,000. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"> On July&nbsp;31, 2026,
the Company commenced offering Class&nbsp;J Shares, par value $0.01 per share. During the month of August 2026, the Company issued additional
5,120,907 Class&nbsp;J Shares for aggregate consideration of $129,815,000. Through the date the consolidated financial statements were
issued, the Company had issued 27,304,707 Class&nbsp;J Shares for aggregate proceeds of approximately $684,410,000. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"> As of September 16, 2026,
the Company received $7,390,000 of capital contributions and the corresponding Shares had not yet been issued as of the date these consolidated
financial statements were issued. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>
